principle: GitHub Actions is reserved for external evidence acquisition, official post-draw settlement, and infrequent integrity gates. Deterministic presentation and derived progress belong in the application/browser whenever persistence is not scientifically required.

CAPTURE_REQUIRED.description: Future evidence that would be lost if the app is closed.

POST_DRAW_REQUIRED.description: Low-frequency official result retrieval/settlement where immutable custody matters.
POST_DRAW_REQUIRED.preferredCadence: daily or aligned to draw calendar

DERIVED_LOCAL.description: Counters, dashboards, ETAs, summaries, ledgers, rankings that remain blinded, and other deterministic views of persisted evidence.

HISTORICAL_MAINTENANCE.description: Backfills, archive enrichment and research audits that do not protect a live prospective sample.

DIAGNOSTIC.description: Source probes, public observers, legacy audits and recovery diagnostics.
